messages:
Maria (CSM): Hi team — kicking off Emerald's launch cadence. Quick doc: https://redwood.app/docs/emerald-kickstart (draft). Need: stakeholders, top 3 success criteria, key dates (30/60/90), and any renewal/contract risk flags. Can we lock timeline by EOW? :spiral_calendar:

Devon (Success Eng): Reviewed the doc. Two questions: do they need SSO config during the 30d? Also we'll need sample traffic for load testing (estimate 50 qps peak).

Sam (AE): Priya is the customer PM. Priya — can you confirm internal stakeholders and any compliance constraints? Also note renewal month is month 11 — flagging potential budget cycle.

Priya (Emerald PM): Thanks. Stakeholders: Ravi (infra), Leila (product), and our security lead Omar. SSO is optional for MVP, but security wants SSO before prod. Budget: renewal is flexible but procurement usually starts ~45 days before renewal.

Devon (Success Eng): Got it. I'll schedule an enablement session: propose Week 1 Thurs 10am PT. Also prepping a checklist — will post here.

Maria (CSM): Proposed success criteria: 1) Staging integration with live traffic replay; 2) 95th percentile latency under 200ms for demo workloads; 3) Team trained + docs handed off. Thoughts?

Sam (AE): Add 'cost baseline established' — we need per-route cost visibility for the customer. Also: any known renewal risks?

Priya (Emerald PM): Risk items to add: 1) SOC2 attestation not yet started (procurement may require); 2) Firewall/IP allowlist delays from infra. I'll add both to the doc's risk register.

OnboardBot: Task created — #EMR-ONB-12 — 'Schedule enablement + collect SSO requirements' assigned to Devon, due in 3 days.

Maria (CSM): Thanks. Action items: Devon to confirm enablement time, Sam to share procurement contact, Priya to add stakeholders' emails. Aim: staging integration by 30 days. :white_check_mark:

Devon (Success Eng): Confirmed Thurs 10am PT. Attaching checklist snippet:
```
- Preflight: API keys, CORS, IP allowlist
- Integration tests: sample payloads (3 key use cases)
- Load run: 50 qps for 5m
- Rollout plan: canary -> full with metrics gates
```

Priya (Emerald PM): Shared stakeholder emails in the doc and pinged Ravi about firewall rules. I'll open procurement thread today. Thanks :raised_hands:

Maria (CSM): Great — I'll update the kickoff doc and send calendar invites after Devon confirms invites. If any blockers, ping me in-thread. Closing for now.
